titulo: What Happens If You Let a Stink Bug Live in Your House All Winter?
titulos_alternativos: Never Kill the Stink Bug in Your House (Here's Why)
The Stink Bug in Your House Is Not Alone
descripcion:
It is a quiet night in late October. You are reading under the lamp and something starts buzzing around the shade. A brown, shield-shaped bug lands on your sleeve. So what happens if you just let it stay all winter?

Meet the brown marmorated stink bug: how one family in Maryland collected more than 26,000 of them inside one house, what they do in your walls all winter, why they wake up on warm days, why they smell like cilantro, and the twist that happens when spring comes.
